idle_side.prompt: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little. It stays in place, facing right.

idle_down.prompt: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

idle_up.prompt: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

walk_side.prompt: Walks in place on four legs: the legs step one after another, the body bobs gently and the tail sways. It stays in place, facing right.

walk_up.prompt: Walks in place on four legs: the legs step one after another, the body bobs gently and the tail sways. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

eat_side.prompt: Lowers its head to the ground, eats the grass with a few bites, then lifts its head back up. It stays in place, facing right.

tail_swing_down.prompt: Keeps its body and head facing the viewer and swings its tail out from behind its body to one side in a wide fast sweep, then back behind it. Only the tail moves. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

hurt_side.prompt: Flinches: jerks its head and body back, then returns to its stance. It stays in place, facing right.
